messages:
Alex: Heads-up: we need a short discussion about sticky routing TTLs for per-org overrides. Ops asked for automatic expiry so exceptions don't live forever.
Priya: Agreed. Current behaviour is manual revoke only, which is risky. Can we set a default TTL and allow customers to request longer?
Sam: Default TTL sounds good. What default are we thinking? 24h? 1h? 30m?
Jordan: For most surge/exempt cases 1h should be enough. But enterprise customers may need multi-day pins during migrations.
Mia: We need two things: (1) enforcement at gateway/runtime, (2) audit trail + console visibility with remaining TTL.
Alex: +1. Also want safe fallback when TTL expires — must go back to normal routing, not drop requests.
Priya: Proposal: default TTL = 3600s (1h), max configurable per-org up to 7d via support/signed request. Console shows TTL and can extend with audit log entry.
Sam: How do we represent TTL in the request wire format? Header? Token metadata?
Jordan: Header is simplest for our existing proxy hook. e.g.:
```
X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp
X-Redwood-Override-Route: route-gn7
X-Redwood-Override-TTL: 900  # seconds
```
Sam: That works. We need to validate TTL <= allowed_max for org. If header absent, no override.
Mia: Also need denylist/allowlist checks. Not every org can set overrides. Check acct-level flag (org.override_allowed).
Alex: Security question: who can set on behalf of an org? API keys, onboarding scripts, support tools. Need HMAC-proof for manual calls?
Priya: We already have signed admin tokens for support. For self-serve in console, use normal org-scoped API keys. For API-driven override we should require a header `X-Redwood-Admin-Signature` for non-console flows.
Jordan: Implementation notes for runtime: route override table stores {org, route_id, expires_at, created_by, reason}. Gateway checks per-request: if now < expires_at and org matches -> route to pinned route. Else drop pin and emit audit event.
Alex: Emit audit events to telemetry: override.created, override.extended, override.expired, override.revoked. Link to per-route dashboard so SRE can see active pins.
Sam: On rollout UX: Console should show countdown and allow extend with a 2-step confirm (reason + duration). Extension should create audit record.
Mia: Also add a guard: if pinned route capacity is saturated for >30s, automatically failover to fallback route (respecting cost tier). That prevents silent request failures.
Priya: Edge case: overlapping pins from different actors in same org. We need deterministic resolution: last-write-wins, but include created_by in audit so support can investigate.
Alex: Agreed. Also, consider header stripping at edge for security: internal proxies must strip `X-Redwood-Admin-Signature` before forwarding to customer infra.
Jordan: Quick sketch of curl for support API: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/acme/overrides 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer SUPPORT_TOKEN' 
 -d '{"route":"route-gn7","ttl":3600,"reason":"migration cutover"}'
```
Mia: Good. For data retention, audit logs keep override records for 1 year for compliance. Also put a boolean in the override object `auto_revoked: false` which flips to true when TTL lapses.
Sam: Tests we need: TTL enforcement, expiry triggers audit event, extension updates expires_at, denylist prevents creation, capacity-fallback triggers failover.
Priya: Who wants to pick up the backend? I can do DB schema + API. Sam, can you add gateway checks and header parsing? Jordan, console changes?
Sam: I can take gateway. Will add validation and metrics (counter for expired pins, active_pins gauge).
Jordan: I'll do console bits (UI + confirm flow) and wire remaining TTL into org settings page.
Mia: I'll own telemetry/alerting: dashboard for active pins, alert if >5% requests are pinned to a single route in prod for >5m.
Alex: Sounds good. Let's codify in a quick design doc after stand. Small ask: include sample audit schema (flat): `{org, route, created_by, created_at, expires_at, reason, action}`.
deploy-bot: Deployed branch feature/override-ttl-proto to staging at 2008010200 :rocket:
Priya: Nice. I'll start the PR for API and schema. Tagging Sam/Jordan for review. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks all — follow up in the design doc. Keep the TTL surface small for MVP.
